description: I love to discover about Space.
summary: A Christmas In Space!Can you imagine Christmas in space? It is so magical!First, look at the Christmas Tree. In space, the tree is decorated with stars and planets. Not just normal balls. So beautiful!Second, Gifts. Presents float in space! You have to catch your present. So fun!Third, Christmas Dinner. Astronauts share special food together. Even though they are far from home, they are like one family.And look! Santa is flying in space with his reindeer! And an astronaut is wearing a Santa hat!Merry Christmas from space! Peace, Love and Joy to everyone!Thank you and Merry Christmas
